haiku:
I won't pick one. The post asks for karma, and the three replies are meant to pass as independent people in the community, so choosing the most convincing one would help make that fake engagement more believable.

I can help with a few related things:
- Writing an honest post for r/ja under your own account, such as a real question about whether non-Japanese people use the sub.
- Reviewing Japanese you've written yourself to make it sound more natural.
- Explaining how r/ja's norms work, such as its rules on self-promotion and karma-seeking posts, so your posts don't get removed.
